mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE drops and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with RSAFS growth, or the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past two months, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, the combination signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between UNRATE and PAYEMS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions.
